rejected_or_superseded_variants.reason: One radial span left elongated quads; boundary creases produced 243 diagnostic candidates.
Radial support plus crease overconstrained the same boundaries and produced 287 diagnostic candidates.

validated_rule: Reconnect outer and opening boundaries with matched low-resolution quad loops, then add localized radial support only where the desired SubD transition requires it. Support loops and creases are not automatically additive; combining both must be justified by highlight and evaluated-surface evidence.
limitations: This reproduces one topology chapter, not the complete controller tutorial.
The artifact studies loop correspondence and boundary behavior, not reference likeness or full product construction.
Diagnostic candidates are heuristic and were interpreted alongside solid and MatCap renders.
